{{nihongo|'''Karakuniitateno Shrine'''|韓国伊太弖神社|Karakuni-itate-no-jinja}} is not one shrine. The ''[[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]'' lists '''five''' shrines of this name in [[Izumo Province]] alone, each standing in the precinct of a different parent shrine. This page explains which is which, because they are easy to mistake for duplicates of one another — and at least once, they were.

== Why there are five ==

The register writes these entries with the prefix '''坐''' (''ni-masu'', "situated in"). An entry beginning 坐 is a shrine standing inside the grounds of the shrine listed '''immediately before it'''. The parent is not repeated in the name, so the entry reads as a bare 韓国伊太弖神社 and its identity comes entirely from its position in the list.

That is the whole reason five entries share a name: they are five separate shrines of 韓国伊太弖, each in someone else's precinct.

|-
| '''28''' || [[d:Q11498399|揖夜神社]] || 坐韓国伊'''大'''弖神社, in '''Iya''' grounds || [[d:Q135040786|Q135040786]]

| 125 || [[d:Q135041043|出雲神社]] || 韓国伊太弖神社, standalone || [[d:Q135041044|Q135041044]]
|}

The 大 / 太 spelling difference at ordinal 28 is '''not''' what distinguishes it. Register transcriptions vary on that character. The precinct is what distinguishes them.

== The merge, and why entries 28 and 39 look alike ==

On '''2026-05-23''', [[d:Q135040908|Q135040908]] — the entry-39 shrine, in Sakuta's grounds — was merged into [[d:Q135040786|Q135040786]], the entry-28 shrine in Iya's grounds. They are two different shrines and the merge conflated them.

It was a reasonable mistake to make. '''Both entries had been given the same two candidate shrines''':

* [[d:Q135070107|Q135070107]] 嘉羅久利神社
* [[d:Q135070108|Q135070108]] 佐久多神社

Two register entries with identical candidate sets read as one entry recorded twice. But 嘉羅久利 (''Karakuri'') is the modern form of 韓国 (''Karakuni''), and that shrine stands in '''Sakuta''' grounds — so those candidates belong to entry '''39''', not to the Iya one. The candidate assignment was wrong before the merge, and it is what made the two entries look identical.

The merge has '''not''' been undone, deliberately: restoring the item would restore the wrong candidate set with it, so the candidates are the thing to fix first.

== What is still tangled ==

* '''There are two 嘉羅久利神社 items.''' [[d:Q135070106|Q135070106]] points at entry 38, [[d:Q135070107|Q135070107]] at entry 28. One shrine, two items, two different entries.
* '''佐久多神社 exists as both an entry and a candidate.''' [[d:Q135040907|Q135040907]] is entry 38 itself; [[d:Q135070108|Q135070108]] is a candidate that also holds ''part of'' the list at ordinal '''39''' — which a candidate should not hold at all.
* '''Entry 38 carries two ''followed by'' values at once''', [[d:Q135040786|Q135040786]] and [[d:Q135040909|Q135040909]], piled into a single statement.
* '''The list's ordinal 39 points at [[d:Q135040786|Q135040786]]''' by following the redirect left behind by the merge.

== Pages on this wiki ==

Each entry has its own page, and one of them is currently mislinked:

* [[Karakuniitateno Shrine (Q135040908)]] — entry '''39''', Sakuta's precinct. ⚠ Its {{tl|wikidata link}} now resolves to '''Q135040786''' because of the merge, so it and this page point at the same item while describing different shrines.
* [[Karakuniitateno Shrine (Q135040960)]] — entry 92, 神韓国伊太弖神社, Asuki's precinct.
* [[Karakuniitateno Shrine (Q135041044)]] — entry 125, standalone.

Not the same shrine, despite similar names: [[Karakuniitatematsuruno Shrine]] (韓國伊太弖奉神社), [[Karakuni Shrine (Q135040666)]] (韓國神社), [[Karakunino- Shrine]] (韓国宇豆峯神社).
